name: Jellyfin + Bonfire
description: Official Jellyfin Tizen client patched with the Bonfire loader for multi-user profile switching. Requires the Bonfire plugin on your Jellyfin server.
pre_build: set -e; JW=${BUILD_CACHE:-/tmp/build-cache}/jellyfin-web-v12.2; if [ ! -f "$JW/dist/index.html" ]; then rm -rf "$JW" ../jellyfin-web; git clone --depth 1 --branch v12.2 https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-web.git ../jellyfin-web; (cd ../jellyfin-web && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm ci --no-audit && USE_SYSTEM_FONTS=1 npm run build:production); mkdir -p "$JW" && cp -R ../jellyfin-web/dist "$JW/dist"; fi; JELLYFIN_WEB_DIR=$JW/dist npm ci --no-audit; sed -i 's/AprZAARz4r/JellyBnfir/g; s#<name>Jellyfin</name>#<name>Jellyfin Bonfire</name>#' config.xml; grep -q JellyBnfir config.xml; curl -fsSL -o www/bonfire-loader.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AHouseOfBards/Bonfire-JellyProfiles/main/Web/tizen/bonfire-loader.js; sed -i 's#</body>#<script src="bonfire-loader.js"></script></body>#' www/index.html; grep -q bonfire-loader.js www/index.html; rm -rf node_modules gulpfile.babel.js package.json package-lock.json
